nurture_ember.name: Nurture the Ember
nurture_ember.tooltip: Tend the central ember. The scattered ones stir in reply.

effects.log: You cup the ember in your hands. It answers with a flare. Scattered embers around you brighten. Shards of forgotten light pulse in the ash.

feed_ember.name: Feed the Ember
feed_ember.tooltip: Feed a shard to the central ember. The pulse strengthens; more embers glow.

effects.log: You feed the ember a shard. The pulse steadies. The dark retreats a step. Other embers glimmer in the ash.

gather_shards.name: Gather Shards
gather_shards.tooltip: Pull warm shards from the embers scattered in the ash. Fuel for the pulse.

raise_haven.name: Raise a Haven
raise_haven.tooltip: A place for more of the lost to stay near the ember. (each brings more, but the weight adds up)

set_foraging.name: Mark the Lines
set_foraging.tooltip: Send them along marked lines in the ash. They return with more.

demand_more.name: Demand More
demand_more.tooltip: Push them for more now. Gets results.
demand_more.unlock_log: A new thought occurs while watching the lost work the ash. It feels like the only natural next step.

effects.log: You reach deeper into them. 'Give more.' The ember brightens. Something in their eyes goes quiet. The ones who stayed at the first haven already knew this demand.

assign_forager.name: Send Forager
assign_forager.tooltip: Put a lost one to work the ash.

effects.log: Another pair of hands sent into the ash.

unassign_forager.name: Call Back Forager
unassign_forager.tooltip: Return them to the ember's light.

defend_paths.name: Defend the Paths
defend_paths.tooltip: Spend shards to watch the paths. Holds back ash threats for a while. (strength fades over time)
defend_paths.unlock_log: The paths are open. Defend what you have claimed.

effects.log: You set watchers on the paths. The lost who walk know eyes are on the ash with them.

queue_labor_hall.name: Queue Hands at the Labor Hall
queue_labor_hall.tooltip: Commit labor and time to train steady hands. They will strengthen the watch and the walks.

effects.log: You set the Hall to work. More hands will answer the pulse.

queue_spire_works.name: Queue Construction at the Spire Works
queue_spire_works.tooltip: Speed the raising of more eyes along the veins.

effects.log: The Works begin shaping new spires. The ash will have more watchers.

queue_dread_foundry.name: Queue at the Dread Foundry
queue_dread_foundry.tooltip: Forge tools that bite. High cost in will, high return in control.

effects.log: The Foundry answers a harder will. The spikes will remember who shaped them.

queue_sanctuary_ward.name: Queue at the Sanctuary Ward
queue_sanctuary_ward.tooltip: Raise protections that remember those who answered willingly.

effects.log: The Ward rises. Those who walk the veins will feel the circle holding them differently.

assign_labor_defense.name: Assign Labor to Defense
assign_labor_defense.tooltip: Commit production labor to bolstering watchers on the veins (C&C: direct your halls' output).

effects.log: Labor turns to the watch. The veins stand a little firmer.

assign_labor_expedition.name: Assign Labor to the Walks
assign_labor_expedition.tooltip: Direct trained hands to aid expeditions along the veins.

effects.log: The labor walks with them. The ash yields a little more readily.

queue_vein_forge.name: Queue at the Vein Forge
queue_vein_forge.tooltip: Work the claimed veins for more steady labor.

effects.log: The Forge takes the vein's yield and returns hands and watchers.

queue_spire_foundry.name: Queue at the Spire Foundry
queue_spire_foundry.tooltip: Push for faster spires and watchers under a harder will.

effects.log: The Foundry answers. All construction quickens under the press of will.

queue_resonance_spire.name: Queue at the Resonance Spire
queue_resonance_spire.tooltip: Call more voices along the veins. They return changed, carrying resonance.

effects.log: The Spire sings. More will answer the circle's call.

queue_will_press.name: Queue at the Will Press
queue_will_press.tooltip: Force the veins for gain. The press remembers the shape of your first demand.

effects.log: The Press works. The ash gives more when you do not ask.

queue_vein_ward.name: Queue at the Vein Ward
queue_vein_ward.tooltip: Raise gentle wards that hold what walks the lines.

effects.log: The Ward stands. The veins feel a little less hungry.

queue_echo_choir.name: Queue at the Echo Choir
queue_echo_choir.tooltip: Call the returned voices. Softens the ash and deepens what the veins give back.

effects.log: The Choir gathers. Voices answer the circle that first sheltered them.

queue_ash_binder.name: Queue at the Ash Binder
queue_ash_binder.tooltip: Bind the claimed ash harder. Gain and retaliation follow the first demand.

effects.log: The Binder works. The ash yields because you taught it to.
